items.prompt: A valid line 8=F|10=188| gains one extra trailing bar. Why is the result BAD_FORMAT?

options.text: All bars are ignored before splitting.
options.why: Removing every trailing delimiter would hide a required empty-field error.
The grammar issue is an empty field, not authentication.
Preserving empty split pieces makes the doubled final delimiter visible.
Structural invalidity is classified before any checksum correction.
